package.json scripts build vs build:hostinger

tests/hostinger-build.test.ts (only checks the script string and the root layout)
verified: VERIFIED: read ci.yml and package.json at origin/main 3bf67673; production/package.json has the same scripts
impact: A webpack-only build or type-check failure (rule 661 class) is invisible until the release PR is merged and Hostinger builds; CI also runs a newer Node than the host. A failed live build is a revert PR plus 2-3 minutes of the old code still serving.
next_action: Add one `npx next build --webpack` step (and node 22) to the job only for pull requests whose base is `production`, so the cost is one extra build per release, not per push. Set `engines.node` in package.json.
